overview: The Medford School Committee approved an updated district Wellness Policy and a $22.7 million schematic design for HVAC electrification and roof repairs at Roberts Elementary. The committee also reallocated nearly $460,000 in capital funds toward intercom systems and mechanical repairs while passing several resolutions concerning student assessments, e-bike safety, and federal internet funding.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including a $35,000 donation from the Cummings Foundation and amended meeting minutes from July 20, 2026.

items.title: Retirement Recognition of Joan Bowen
items.summary: The committee and administration honored Director of Student Services Joan Bowen for her 33 years of service to Medford Public Schools upon her retirement.

items.title: MPS Wellness Policy Update
items.summary: Approved the updated district Wellness Policy, which aligns with Department of Elementary and Secondary Education (DESE) standards for nutrition, physical activity, and social-emotional health.

items.title: Roberts Elementary HVAC and Roof Schematic Design
items.summary: Approved the schematic design for an estimated $22.7 million renovation of the Roberts Elementary roof and HVAC systems, utilizing air-to-water heat pump technology for building electrification.

items.title: FY27 Capital Projects Adjustments
items.summary: Approved the reallocation of $210,000 in project savings to district-wide intercom systems and $250,000 to various mechanical, drainage, and athletic turf repairs.

items.title: Resolution 2026-06: School Committee Rules
items.summary: Approved the updated School Committee rules incorporating edits from prior sessions.

items.title: Resolution 2026-20: Student Assessment Landscape
items.summary: Referred a request for a comprehensive report on the district's standardized testing and assessment schedule to the Subcommittee for Curriculum and Instruction.

items.title: Resolution 2026-21: E-Bike Safety Education
items.summary: Approved a resolution to provide students and families with educational materials regarding e-bike laws and safety practices within the first month of the school year.

items.title: Resolution 2026-22: High School Building Committee Appointments
items.summary: Appointed several new voting and non-voting members to the Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee through June 2027.

items.title: Resolution 2026-23: E-Rate Program Support
items.summary: Approved a resolution urging the FCC to preserve and fully fund the E-Rate program, which provides approximately $278,000 in annual internet subsidies for the district.
